messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — spike of repeated WS reconnects for EU region starting ~10:12 UTC. Console shows session churn and tenant quota meter jumps. Anyone else seeing this?
Ryan Patel: saw it too, picking up ~10:11:50. Proxy logs show a burst of 502s from edge->runtime for ~2m.
Kevin Ortiz: Is this tied to the sticky-routing tweak we rolled in canary last night?
Maria Chen: Canary toggle was at 03:00 UTC. This noise started at 10:12 — different window, but route swap could still have ripple effects for warm caches.
Samir Desai: Logs look like session PURGE then immediate client reconnects with resume id mismatches. My guess: resume-token rotation + quota backpressure causing reconnect storms.
Samir Desai: excerpt from proxy logs: ```
[10:12:03] session: closed tenant=acct-45 reason=quota-fallback status=200
[10:12:03] client: reconnect id=abc123 -> resume rejected err=resume_mismatch
[10:12:04] client: reconnect id=def456 -> accepted
```
Maria Chen: console only surfaces per-route token counts and connection opens; we don't have a metric for resume_id_rejects or resume_retries. That's hurting triage.
Ryan Patel: agree — need resume_id_rejects as a counter and a reconnect-rate per-tenant timeseries. alert if reconnect-rate > 5/min sustained for 3m.
Kevin Ortiz: Also UX: the rollout view doesn't call out that sticky-routing changes can cause short-term quota warming. We should add a note and a disabling guard for tenants with high reconnect-rate.
Samir Desai: Short mitigation: bump proxy "resume-backoff-debounce" from 5s -> 30s and increase grace window to 30s so clients with stale resume tokens don't thrash.
Maria Chen: I'll try the change in proxy-test first. Tagging @deploy-bot to flip flag there.
deploy-bot: toggle resume-backoff-debounce -> 30s applied to proxy-test at 10:45 UTC by Maria Chen.
Console QA: can we add a small sparkline in Streaming -> Route detail for per-tenant reconnect-rate + a tooltip that links to rollout notes? It's hard to spot these without it.
Kevin Ortiz: Filed a tiny PR to add metric and alert: https://stash.redwood.ai/p/eng/streaming-metrics/pull/62 (adds resume_id_rejects counter + tenant reconnect-rate graph).
Ryan Patel: Meanwhile, I pushed a temporary rule to drop resume rotation during canary window for affected tenants. Monitoring.
Maria Chen: Good. After 20m of observation the reconnects subsided in proxy-test. We'll schedule the metric rollout and a console UX blurb in next sprint.
Maria Chen: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if it reappears in prod. Thanks all :thumbsup:
